dogecoin.text:
Wanna know a painful story? Here it is...

Back in January of this year, I had roughly 195,000 Dogecoin. This was back when it was half a cent each. I sold them when it reached 1 cent.

NOW... If I weren't smooth brained and held onto them, I would have... $75,000.

Pain.

Now, Dogecoin hit 0.55 today. Which means... I WOULD have roughly 107000 dollars. And it hit 0.60 today as a high... which means... I would have hit 117000. 

Fucking pain.
